name: goofytd
description: CowTD: goofy first-person tower defense. No build step for the site; this file only tells Node the sources are ES modules and gives shortcuts. `npm run wasm` rebuilds the Rust sim core (CI does it too).

scripts.wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path sim-rs/Cargo.toml && cp sim-rs/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/cowtd_sim.wasm src/sim/wasm/sim.wasm && node tools/stamp.js
